short_title: Fiscal Year 2026 Budget Support Act of 2025 (tipped minimum wage changes)

parts.description: Tipped minimum wage held flat, then set as a percentage of the regular minimum wage.
Replaces the voter-approved Initiative 82 schedule that would have ended the tip credit.
Budget support acts carry many unrelated policy changes alongside the budget.
District laws undergo a congressional review period before taking effect (inferred).

daily_life: A DC server's base wage stays lower and tips remain part of pay.
notes: Budget Support Act as a policy vehicle; DC laws also need a congressional review period.

parts.description: Adopts agency appropriations for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026.
Act 26-147 was transmitted to Congress for Home Rule Act review; federal payments in the budget depend on separate congressional appropriation.

touches: Congressional review and separate federal payments
daily_life: Council budget authority funds District services; specified federal payments depend on separate congressional appropriation.
notes: D.C. Law Library identifies Bill 26-260, Act 26-147 and October 23, 2025 effective date. B26-0264 is a different FY2025 revised budget bill; July 2025 was Council consideration, not this law’s effective date.
